mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chatroom_info ( chatroom_name, chatroom_description, owner_seq, max_participant_num, use_yn, public_yn, room_pwd, reg_dt, mod_dt ) VALUES ( #{chatroomName}, #{chatroomDescription}, #{ownerSeq}, #{maxParticipantNum}, 'Y', #{publicYn}, #{roomPwd}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT c.chatroom_seq, c.chatroom_name, c.chatroom_description, c.owner_seq, u.nickname AS ownerNickname, c.max_participant_num, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chatroom_participant p WHERE p.chatroom_seq = c.chatroom_seq ) AS currentParticipantNum, c.use_yn, c.public_yn, c.room_pwd, c.reg_dt, c.mod_dt FROM chatroom_info c LEFT OUTER JOIN user_info u ON c.owner_seq = u.user_seq WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y'
AND ( c.chatroom_name ILIKE '%' || #{text} || '%' OR c.chatroom_description ILIKE '%' || #{text} || '%' )
AND c.public_yn = 'Y'
ORDER BY reg_dt DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chatroom_info c LEFT OUTER JOIN user_info u ON c.owner_seq = u.user_seq WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y'
AND ( c.chatroom_name ILIKE '%' || #{text} || '%' OR c.chatroom_description ILIKE '%' || #{text} || '%' )
AND c.public_yn = 'Y'
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{page}

SELECT c.chatroom_seq, c.chatroom_name, c.chatroom_description, c.owner_seq, c.max_participant_num, c.use_yn, c.public_yn, c.room_pwd, c.reg_dt, c.mod_dt FROM chatroom_info c WHERE c.chatroom_seq = #{chatroomSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chatroom_participant(participant_seq, chatroom_seq, participant_type) VALUES (#{participantSeq}, #{chatroomSeq}, #{participantType})
mapper.update: UPDATE chatroom_info SET chatroom_name = #{chatroomName}, chatroom_description = #{chatroomDescription}, max_participant_num = #{maxParticipantNum}, public_yn = #{publicYn}, room_pwd = #{roomPwd}, mod_dt = NOW() WHERE chatroom_seq = #{chatroomSeq} AND use_yn = 'Y'
